The Best Bees Company supports honeybee care, client services, and pollinator research through beekeeping and scientific research. The Junior FileMaker Developer will build and improve the company’s custom FileMaker ERP platform, mobile field application, integrations, and automations while testing, documenting, and supporting internal systems.
Agriculture
Construction
Facilities Support Services
Farming
Culture & Values
Responsibilities
Build and improve layouts, scripts, calculations, and database relationships within Bzz
Work with the Chief Operating Officer and internal users to understand operational needs
Translate those needs into practical, maintainable improvements
Document changes and participate in code review
Own scoped projects with guidance, review, and increasing independence as your skills develop
Improve MobileBzzz, our mobile application for field operations
Refine interfaces to make everyday tasks easier for field staff
Help develop and maintain login, authentication, and application update workflows
Gather user feedback and translate it into improvements that support reliable work in the field
Help maintain and extend connections between Bzz and services such as QuickBooks Online, Google Sheets, Slack, and payment processors
Learn our integration patterns using AWS Lambda and Amazon S3
Investigate integration errors and troubleshoot data flows
Improve existing automations to reduce manual work and increase reliability
Reproduce, investigate, and resolve reported bugs
Test changes before release and document expected behavior
Work with the Chief Operating Officer to review changes before they reach production
Apply access controls and protect data integrity under guidance
Create clear documentation that helps the team understand and maintain the system
Communicate progress, questions, and blockers promptly
Qualification
Programming
Scripting
Required
A foundation in programming or scripting, demonstrated through work, coursework, personal projects, or equivalent experience
Ability to think logically, break problems into manageable steps, and troubleshoot methodically
Interest in building sustained expertise in FileMaker and business systems
Clear written communication and willingness to document work and collaborate asynchronously
Curiosity about understanding and improving a mature, highly customized platform
Attention to detail, reliability, and follow-through
Willingness to ask questions, receive feedback, and learn
Preferred
Experience developing in Claris FileMaker
Familiarity with relational databases and data modeling
Experience with JavaScript, Python, SQL, or similar languages
Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, or authentication concepts
Exposure to AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, or third-party business integrations
Experience testing software or supporting internal users
Interest in sustainability, environmental science, or conservation
If you have a relevant project or code sample you are able to share, you may include it
Benefits
Hands-on projects, direct mentorship, and code review
Opportunities to deepen your technical expertise, strengthen your understanding of business operations, and help shape the future of Best Bees' internal systems
